visual_action: The video opens with a still image of a leopard resting on a tree branch at night, its face illuminated. Overlaid text appears. After a few seconds, it cuts to a heavily saturated and brightly lit still photograph of Donald Trump at a podium, with an American flag in the background. He is squinting and smiling, and his skin appears very orange.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: An over-saturated still photograph of his face is used as the punchline of the video.

on_screen_text.text: When the sun hits my face at the perfect angle and my skin looks glowy and sunkissed on sum majestic shi

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue. The audio consists of lyrics from the song 'Earned It' by The Weeknd.
audio_music: The video is set to the slow, romantic R&B song 'Earned It (Fifty Shades Of Grey)' by The Weeknd. The song's tone is used ironically to contrast the 'majestic' text with the unflattering image of Donald Trump.
editing_pacing: The video consists of two static images with a single hard cut between them, functioning as a slideshow.
manipulation_or_satire: The photograph of Donald Trump is visually manipulated with high color saturation and brightness to exaggerate his skin tone, making it appear intensely orange and 'glowy' for a mocking effect.
cultural_references: The video uses a common meme format where text sets up an expectation that is subverted by a punchline image.
central_claim: Donald Trump's appearance, particularly his tan, is unnatural and ridiculous.
intended_effect: To mock Donald Trump's appearance and encourage viewers to find him laughable.
